Veteran Nollywood actress Sola Sobowale has officially opened Joseph and Esther Homes, a residential care facility for older adults located in the Akobo area of Ibadan, Oyo State.
Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde commissioned the facility on Tuesday, touring the indoor and outdoor premises and commending the initiative.
